description: Create 5 marketplace components in Frontend/src/components/marketplace/ for listings, categories, search, filters, and location selection. Refactor existing ListingCard with memoization and LQIP optimization, extract CategoryTile and SearchBar from pages, extract FilterPanel from SearchPage, create LocationPicker. All components optimized for performance (React.memo), accessibility (WCAG AA), and RTL support.
steps: Refactor Frontend/src/components/ListingCard.tsx → Frontend/src/components/marketplace/ListingCard.tsx: wrap ListingCard and ListingCardGrid exports in React.memo; add dataSaver prop for gradient placeholder; add loading prop for Skeleton rendering; implement LQIP blur-up (blurDataURL with filter blur(8px) and transition on load); keep grid + list layouts

Create Frontend/src/components/marketplace/CategoryTile.tsx: props (category {id, nameAr, name, icon}, onClick, featured bool, size 'sm'|'md'); design rounded-2xl card, icon top (emoji/SVG), label bottom; RTL centered; hover shadow-md + scale(1.02); featured ring-2 ring-accent-500; React.memo wrapped

Create Frontend/src/components/marketplace/SearchBar.tsx: props (value, onChange, onSubmit, placeholder, suggestions string[], showFilters bool, onFilterToggle); combobox pattern (role='combobox', aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant); suggestions dropdown max 6 items; RTL search icon on end; keyboard (Enter=search, Esc=close, arrows navigate); debounced 300ms onChange

Create Frontend/src/components/marketplace/FilterPanel.tsx: props (filters FilterState, onChange, onReset, resultCount); FilterState {category, subcategory, city, minPrice, maxPrice, condition}; desktop card sidebar, mobile BottomSheet; collapsible filter groups via disclosure; apply + reset buttons; React.memo on pure sections

Create Frontend/src/components/marketplace/LocationPicker.tsx: props (cityId, areaId, onChange({cityId,areaId}), label, error, required); cascading selects City → Area; city change clears area; shows full label 'Khartoum - Jabrein'; uses sudanCities from mockData; RTL logical padding
Create Frontend/src/components/marketplace/index.ts: barrel export for all 5 components
Update Frontend/src/components/ListingCard.tsx to re-export from marketplace version (or move entirely)
acceptance_criteria: ListingCard refactored with React.memo, dataSaver prop, loading prop, LQIP blur-up
CategoryTile supports featured state, size variants, hover animation
SearchBar implements combobox pattern, keyboard navigation, debounced search, RTL icons
FilterPanel handles all filter types, mobile BottomSheet, collapsible groups
LocationPicker cascades cities and areas, shows combined label
All components wrapped in React.memo where appropriate
All components support RTL via logical CSS (ps-, pe-, start, end)
npm run typecheck passes with zero errors
verification: Import all components: verify 'import { ListingCard, CategoryTile, SearchBar, FilterPanel, LocationPicker } from @/components/marketplace'
npm run build — includes all marketplace components
Render in dev server: verify memoization works, LQIP transitions, filter interactions, location cascading
